results.title: Jordan Love Wears NFL Referee Costume Igniting Controversy
results.description: Green Bay Packers quarterback Jordan Love and his wife Ronika Stone dressed as NFL referees for Halloween, sparking backlash after a recent officiating controversy cost the team against the Detroit Lions.

results.title: Virat Kohli Turns 38: 'King Kohli' Receives Heartwarming Birthday Wishes As Cricket Fraternity And Fans Flood Social Media With Love
results.description: Virat Kohli celebrates his 38th birthday on November 5, with wishes pouring in from fans, former cricketers, celebrities & the cricket fraternity. Social media is flooded with heartfelt messages celebrating the Indian batting star's incredible career and achievements. The former India captain's birthday has turned into a global celebration, with fans showering their beloved 'King Kohli' with love.

results.title: Senators’ Ridly Greig day-to-day with lower-body injury
results.description: Ottawa Senators forward Ridly Greig is being considered day-to-day with a lower-body injury, head coach Travis Green confirmed following Wednesday night’s 2-1 win over the Buffalo Sabres.
